MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS birth
WITH p,
  2026 - CAST(date_part('year', birth) AS INT64) - CASE
    WHEN CAST(date_part('month', birth) AS INT64) > 10

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2) AS INT64)
       ELSE NULL END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'December' THEN 12
       ELSE NULL END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 1), ' ', 2) AS INT64)
       ELSE NULL END AS birth_day
WITH p, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  CASE WHEN birth_year IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS age
WHERE age > 42 OR p.name <> 'Fran Curran Francis Hugh Curran Sr.' OR p.name = 'Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr.' OR TRY_CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) = 1
RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.college AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
